name: bug_repro_gate
description: Bug fix (roadmap Phase 4, G2): gate the fix on a genuine reproduction. The authored regression test must be RED (test_run verificationState=failed) at the parent commit; a passing run is cannot_reproduce (an honest stop, never a silent fix); a blocked run is an infrastructure block.

verificationState.description: Raw test_run verdict at the repro commit: failed = reproduced (red), passed = cannot_reproduce, else blocked.
